## What's Changed
### ⚠️ Compatibility Notes
* Add the `computer` tool contract to core: `pydantic_ai.computer_use` and `ComputerTool` by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11006
  * Adds `ComputerTool` to `NATIVE_TOOLS_REQUIRING_CONFIG`: it needs a `computer` tool to run its calls.
* [cache] Send static instructions as leading `input` messages on GPT-6.2, which never caches top-level `instructions` by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/14095
  * Continuing a GPT-6.2 response through an explicit `openai_previous_response_id='resp_…'` without its `message_history` now inherits that response's static instructions. Pass the `message_history`, or `profile=OpenAIModelProfile(openai_responses_stable_instructions_as_input=False)`.
* Stop summing Gemini's running usage totals when streaming through `OpenAIChatModel` by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/14285
  * Streaming a `gemini*` model through `OpenAIProvider` now reports the endpoint's final usage totals instead of their sum, so cost figures d
